label: Reductio ad Absurdum
description: Pushes an accepted claim or system logic to an absurd extreme, clearly exposing contradictions, unsustainable costs, dependencies, and critical questions.

zh.label: 归谬推演
zh.description: 将已被接受的主张或系统逻辑推向荒谬极端，暴露其中的矛盾、不可持续成本、依赖关系与批判性问题。

theory_mapping.source_notes: 思辨设计tools-3.pdf pages 8-11, Reductio ad Absurdum / 荒谬归谬实验.

model_constraints: Temporarily accept one common claim, rule, or logic.
Push that logic to an extreme consequence.
Use absurdity, humor, or incompatibility to reveal the original problem.
Make the critique legible through an object, process, task, or system dependency.

For humanoid systems, push a normalized premise such as human resemblance, universal substitution, frictionless autonomy, or trust-by-appearance until its governance, labor, or value contradiction becomes concrete.

Do not make a safety log or component failure the central critique unless the direct inputs make it central; prefer an artifact that exposes the gap between claimed human equivalence and demonstrated public value.
Preserve the required tool information structure while using the package output_budget; remove repeated framing and keep evidence, tables, and questions concise.

reject_if: output only mocks without exposing logic

recommendation.reason: Reductio ad Absurdum benefits from pairing a written logical escalation with an absurd artifact, task, process, or system record that makes the critique inspectable.
best_when: A common claim, metric, optimization logic, or system rule is being treated as natural.
The user needs to expose hidden dependencies, costs, or contradictions.
Humor, incompatibility, or over-literal execution can clarify the critique.

avoid: random absurdity without a critique target
mockery that does not reveal the original logic

warnings: Use multimodal only when the generated object or process remains tied to the accepted claim.
